scope.probeScope: The explicitly clamped feature bench and its relocated floor are feasibility evidence only. Final qualification uses the structurally complete exported model in the ordinary native session.
scope.defaultNativeNumericalRepairs: Ordinary runtime-derived mass floors and inertia repair are retained and recorded, not overridden. The passive pendulum and carriage remain unadjusted; configured and admitted properties of every dynamic body are disclosed below.

comparison.programDifferenceAllowed: Exactly one numeric assignment: GLOBAL start_gap. Executable text otherwise matches after that literal is normalized; comments and filenames may identify the two programs.
comparison.dampingConfoundDisclosure: The common absolute window equalizes elapsed trial time, but the shaped run arrives about half a period earlier and therefore has extra passive decay after arrival. A second equal-duration arrival-relative comparison and an independent free-ringdown bound are also required.
comparison.absoluteWaypointExplanation: Both programs command the same first and second motor-angle targets, using the same target-minus-fresh-normal-Robot-Lab-encoder algorithm and speed. Actual relative API degree arguments may differ by the observed tracking/rounding error. This is disclosed and constrained by the unchanged actual half-travel, endpoint and pulse-profile gates.
comparison.decisionProvenance: Root selected absolute waypoints before full qualification, relayed by native_runtime on 2026-10-27. Draft v1 remains preserved.

calibration.chosenMethod: separate serialized free-period calibration before comparison qualification
allowedMethods: actual admitted native mass, COM, local inertia tensor, gravity and pivot
separate serialized free-period calibration before comparison qualification
calibration.roundingRule: Round T/2 once to the nearest 0.005 s, then use exactly twice that gap for the in-phase program. Preserve the unrounded period and rounding error.
calibration.formula: T = 2*pi*sqrt((axis^T I_COM axis + m*d^2)/(m*|g|*gravityFactor*d)); d is perpendicular COM-to-hinge distance.
calibration.freeCalibrationExplanation: A separate saved initial pose may incline the complete pendulum by 5 degrees around its real hinge. It must preserve all constraints and use normal motor hold; no velocity or force injection. A final-scene calibration is distinct from the earlier clamped feature bench.
calibration.selectionRule: Arithmetic mean of every observed positive-going crossing interval in the prescribed 8T window; no interval rejection or timing optimization.

This proves the timeout branch, not a physical-stall detector. The production exports remain unchanged.

The new−78degree bound corresponds to less physical travel than the old−49degree5:1 bound. Independent actual-travel, guide-end and continuous-envelope limits are unchanged.

observerRules.angleSource: Observed physical pendulum part-local points carried by native body poses. The actual admitted COM supplies a fixed equilibrium offset; the native joint angle and motor encoder are supplementary cross-checks only.
observerRules.travelSource: Observed carriage part-local point in the observed chassis frame, projected on the physical guide direction.
observerRules.periodAndDampingSource: Independent observed pendulum angles in settled, stationary-carriage free ringdown; never the commanded period or joint encoder as an observed result.
observerRules.rms: Time-weighted root-mean-square of signed gravity-relative angle, without fitting away a constant offset; interpolate window endpoints and report extrema separately.
observerRules.timestamps: Use session milliseconds for command scheduling and the completed native-step seconds for velocity/period analysis. Record both; do not mistake render-frame time for the last physics step.
observerRules.velocity: Compare world COM pose differences with actual native COM velocities, and part-marker angular differences with actual relative body angular velocities. All records used by a difference must be within the same admitted contact-free measurement interval.
observerRules.windowSelection: All window boundaries are prescribed formulas using the frozen T and observed command timestamps. No window search, fitted phase selection, demeaning, amplitude-dependent trimming or best-run selection.
observerRules.retentionAndClearance: Observe actual part-local guide/rack endpoints over the whole run; physical retention and suppressed connected-part clearance also require the independent construction audit. Native absence of contact alone is insufficient.
observerRules.missingData: Missing, nonfinite, duplicate-clock or truncated required data fail qualification; they are not silently dropped.
